## A figure from R

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4.5
depth <- seq(0, 300, by = 5)
sv <- -70 + 15 * exp(-((depth - 120) / 40)^2) + rnorm(length(depth), 0, 1.5)
plot(sv, depth, type = "l", ylim = rev(range(depth)), col = "#0076a9", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Sv (dB re 1 m⁻¹)", ylab = "Depth (m)", las = 1, bty = "l")
```
